decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to the firm's existing fabricated fluid-handling offer, management is likely to continue backing it and explain any weak early demand as normal market ramp-up.

Although public waste bins are more distant from the core offer, the product still fits the firm's metalworking and public-sector sales capabilities, and recent visible commitment makes withdrawal less likely so soon after launch.
Ground sleeves are a close adjacency to the firm's established metal fabrication business, so sunk setup effort and strategic logic both support retaining the product.
Cast iron ground sleeves extend an announced product family and use familiar production and sales capabilities, which encourages management to persist rather than reverse course quickly.
Steel ground sleeves are strongly aligned with the firm's steel-processing strengths and newly broadened market direction, making continued support the likely decision.
